THE RECOVERY LOOP / FIVE DELIBERATE STEPS

From the first clue
to the final check.

01

Investigate

Match the records. Let Prism challenge the proposal and resolve objections before rehearsal.

02

Rehearse

Try the proposed access grant on a copy. Review exactly what would change.

03

Approve

You approve one specific plan. Changed evidence requires a new preview.

04

Repair

Grant the purchased access once. Leave the original payment alone.

05

Verify

Read the payment and access record again, then check the purchased resource.

A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Clear boundaries.
From day one.

Who is this for?

Merchants handling “I paid, but I can’t access it” requests. The first example is a paid course. Memberships and downloads are future directions to validate.

Can an agent approve a repair?

No. Agents help inspect and explain evidence. The merchant approves a specific change, and application checks determine whether it can proceed. Changed evidence requires a fresh review.

What happens if access still cannot be verified?

The case stays unresolved. The demo includes a failed verification read that can be retried without granting access again.

Can I connect my store today?

This is a hackathon prototype, not a production store integration. The live build starts with a controlled course service and PayPal sandbox. A real course-platform connector comes after that flow is validated.
